data.one_liner: Capture multiple photos in one camera session on Android and iOS with previews and custom done widget.
data.what_it_does: Opens a full-screen camera preview enabling users to capture multiple photos in a single session. It provides pinch-to-zoom, camera switching, captured-image thumbnails, and returns the selected media list to the app.
use_when: You need to capture multiple photos in a single camera workflow.
You want built-in features like front/rear switching and image previews before returning files.
avoid_when: You need video recording or audio capture.
strengths: Allows multiple photo captures in one continuous session.
Includes built-in image previews and a customizable Done action widget.
weaknesses: Closing the route without Done returns an empty list rather than preserving state.
The removal control deletes only the latest image from the capture list.
Zoom gestures are not clamped to the camera's supported zoom range.
data.setup_notes: Add NSCameraUsageDescription in iOS Info.plist and set minimum Android SDK to at least 21.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard system image picker instead of a custom multi-capture camera session.
